message.knightly_maid.transfer_failed: The maid cannot be moved there right now
knightly_maid.configuration.followAcross: Bring your following maids (on foot or on their horse) along when you change dimension. Touhou Little Maid only lets them follow within a dimension. Maids seated on your dragon back always come along.
knightly_maid.configuration.verboseLoggi: Log what the mod does with seated and riding maids (seating, teleports, dimension changes, blocked dismounts, saddle transfers) to latest.log. For troubleshooting; can be noisy.
